premise: Acorn wants to grow up high at once, but the first thing she grows is a root, down, down, before she ever goes up.
inspiration: Jack and the Beanstalk, turned slow and true: no overnight giant, just a root holding on first, and the old tree who began the same way.
lesson: Growing starts with holding on; the rest comes in time.
learning: An acorn grows a root down first, then a shoot up

en-US.title: Acorn Starts to Grow
en-US.text: Acorn {acorn:pulse} lay on the soft ground in spring. [excited] Today, she said, I'm going to grow up, up, up, as tall as Tree! She took a deep breath. She pushed. [curious] Was she growing? Pinecone {pinecone:wobble} looked. Hmm, she said. You're not going up. Acorn looked down instead. [gasps] A little white root was wiggling out of her, down, down, down into the soft earth. That's backwards! said Acorn. The old tree {tree:wobble 0.4} chuckled. [softly] No, little one. That's how it starts. First you hold on tight. Then you grow. So Acorn held on, and waited. And one morning… {acorn:sparkle} a tiny green shoot poked up into the sunshine, with two small leaves. [happily] Up! cried Acorn. {acorn:hop} Pinecone {pinecone:hearts} cheered, and Tree {tree:glow} rustled with pride.

es-ES.title: Bellota empieza a crecer
es-ES.text: Bellota {acorn:pulse} estaba en la tierra blandita, en primavera. [excited] Hoy, dijo, voy a crecer hacia arriba, arriba, arriba, ¡tan alta como Árbol! Respiró hondo. Empujó. [curious] ¿Estaba creciendo? Piña {pinecone:wobble} la miró. Mmm, dijo. No estás subiendo. Bellota miró hacia abajo. [gasps] Una raicita blanca le salía meneándose, abajo, abajo, abajo, hacia la tierra blandita. ¡Esto va al revés!, dijo Bellota. El viejo árbol {tree:wobble 0.4} se rio bajito. [softly] No, pequeña. Así se empieza. Primero te agarras fuerte. Luego creces. Así que Bellota se agarró, y esperó. Y una mañana… {acorn:sparkle} un brote verde y chiquitito asomó al sol, con dos hojitas. [happily] ¡Arriba!, gritó Bellota. {acorn:hop} Piña {pinecone:hearts} lo celebró, y Árbol {tree:glow} susurró con orgullo.
